messages:
Jordan: quick heads-up — after onboarding nova-30k (int4) I see divergence vs float16 on longprefill flows when context > 32k, looks like prefetch/handshake ordering is different :thinking_face:
Anya: can you paste the minimal repro? which branch and quant pipeline did you use?
Jordan: on branch release/serve-v2; quant pipeline is q4-int4-optimize. repro (run on a single shard VM):
```bash
export MODEL=nova-30k
./tests/long_prefill_repro.sh --model $MODEL --quant int4 --context 36000 --prefetch-window 8192
```
Jordan: logs show repeated warnings: `prefetch: handshake: inconsistent-fingerprint shard=3 seq=...` then token mismatch at step ~12500
Sam: seeing similar mismatch in local sim — int4 trace has key reorder events: `PREFETCH_PUSH id=0x7f...` followed by `HANDSHAKE_ACK id=0x6f...` (ids not matching)
Lee: hmm could be stride vs shard-reindex race during async prefetch. Can you try forcing `PREFETCH_SYNC=1` to disable async path?
Jordan: tried that, reduced mismatch rate but didn't eliminate it. attaching small log snippet:
```
[12:03:11] prefetch push shard=3 window=8192 id=0x7f2a
[12:03:11] handshake start shard=3 id=0x7f2a
[12:03:12] prefetch push shard=3 window=8192 id=0x6f11
[12:03:12] handshake ack shard=3 id=0x6f11
[12:03:12] token-check: expected=token_12498 actual=token_12497
```
Anya: can you run cross-quant diff with same random seed and dump KV fingerprints? short script: `python tools/dump_kv_fingerprints.py --model nova-30k --seed 42 --len 36000 --quant {float16,int4}`
Sam: ran that — fingerprints align until ~11k tokens then diverge; divergence correlates with a prefetch window boundary at 8192 multiples
Lee: maybe prefetch window size interacts poorly with rotary scaling when windows wrap. we had a similar but noisier symptom on another model earlier.
Jordan: hypothesis: prefetch id generation is per-request but reindexing on shard join uses a separate counter; under async prefetch the counters can be reused causing stale entries to overwrite live ones
Anya: plan: 1) reproduce with `PREFETCH_SYNC=0` and `PREFETCH_WINDOW=4096/8192/16384` matrix 2) add guard to handshake that verifies sender-provided fingerprint 3) run canary on dedicated pool
Jordan: will run matrix tonight and upload artifacts to /tmp/nova_longprefill/1822123456.tar.gz
ml-bot: automated longprefill-eval queued (task id: lp-82734). initial run (float16) completed: pass. int4 run in queue.
Sam: quick note — quantized kernel picks different chunk sizes which can change scheduling; include `--force-kernel=scalar` in tests to normalize scheduling for root-cause
Lee: I'll open a short-lived canary on dedicated (cc @ops-bot) — can we get 4 GPUs pinned for 2 hours at 02:00 UTC?
ops-bot: request received. reserving 4xA100 for team-ml from 2024-11-02T02:00Z to 2024-11-02T04:00Z. quota ok.
Anya: after matrix we'll add small invariant check that fails fast when handshake id != prefetch id and logs full stack — reduces blast radius.
Jordan: thanks — I'll start runs and post TL;DR. if this reproduces reliably we can ship handshake guard as hotfix. :thumbsup:
Sam: ping if you want me to bisect kernel changes; I can run delta tests across quant commits
Lee: tagging this for postmortem if we find correlation to quant kernel change.
Jordan: uploaded artifacts: /tmp/nova_longprefill/1822123456.tar.gz (contains logs, kv-dumps, seed/command)
Anya: perfect. leaving checklist here: [ ] matrix runs complete [ ] kv-fingerprint diffs uploaded [ ] canary runs green/failed [ ] handshake guard PR if needed
Jordan: logging progress in the ticket: INF-1429. will update when matrix finishes. :rocket:
